project.primary_goal: Evolve the application from basic farm record keeping into an operational and financial monitoring system for an egg farm.

general.title: Rename application
general.requirement: Replace the application display name 'Telur Tracker' with 'Cinz Farm'.
acceptance_criteria: No user-facing primary header still displays 'Telur Tracker'.

general.title: Localized date format
general.requirement: Display dates using a localized Indonesian human-readable format.

general.title: System-wide numeric precision
general.requirement: Values representing production quantity and other fractional quantities must support 3 decimal places.
general.implementation_note: Implement this consistently at database, validation, API, and frontend display levels rather than patching individual forms.

authentication_and_authorization.title: Admin role
authentication_and_authorization.requirement: Admin users have full application access.

authentication_and_authorization.title: Restricted Cinz user
authentication_and_authorization.requirement: The Cinz user must not be allowed to delete records.

authentication_and_authorization.title: Standard Mami user
authentication_and_authorization.requirement: Mami is treated as a normal user.
authentication_and_authorization.open_question: Exact permissions for a normal user are not explicitly defined in the source feedback.

authentication_and_authorization.title: Fix admin user creation
authentication_and_authorization.requirement: Fix the issue where an admin cannot create another user.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated admin can create a new user.
Created user can subsequently authenticate if account creation succeeds.
Currently admin can't create user for unknown reasons, which must be fixed. and it only shows error [object] [object]

we assume it fails silently without a clear error message, because of password length or other validation issues. The fix should ensure that the admin receives a clear error message if user creation fails. (remove password requirement for now)

dashboard.title: Weekly egg production chart
dashboard.requirement: Provide a histogram or bar chart showing weekly egg production within the selected monthly period.
acceptance_criteria: The selected month is divided into weekly groups.
Each weekly group displays aggregated production.

dashboard.title: FCR trend
dashboard.requirement: Display Feed Conversion Rate as a historical trend.

formula.name: FCR
formula.numerator: Total feed consumption in kilograms for the selected period
formula.denominator: Total egg production in kilograms for the same period

acceptance_criteria: FCR is calculated from feed consumption and production within the same period.
The configured target can be visually compared to actual FCR.
dashboard.open_question: Confirm whether the stated FCR target of 0.2 is correct before treating it as a permanent business rule.

dashboard.title: HDP trend
dashboard.requirement: Display Hen Day Production as a historical graph.
acceptance_criteria: HDP can be calculated per day.
A target of greater than 85 percent can be compared against actual performance.

production.title: Production quantity precision
production.requirement: Production quantity in kilograms must support 3 decimal places.

production.title: Average egg weight
production.requirement: Add an input for the average weight of one egg in kilograms.
production.purpose: Estimate the number of eggs produced from production weight.

production.title: Estimated egg count
production.requirement: Calculate estimated egg count based on production weight and average egg weight.

sales.title: Sales quantity precision
sales.requirement: Sales quantity must support 3 decimal places.

transactions.title: Unit price
transactions.requirement: Add unit price to transaction records.

transactions.title: Feed purchase unit
transactions.requirement: For transactions categorized as feed, quantity should be recorded in sacks rather than kilograms.

transactions.title: Feed sack to kilogram conversion
transactions.requirement: Support conversion of feed quantities from sacks to kilograms.
transactions.purpose: Provide feed consumption data in kilograms for FCR calculation.
transactions.open_question: The source feedback does not define how many kilograms are contained in one sack. This should be configurable or explicitly defined.

assets.title: Asset quantity
assets.requirement: Add quantity when creating an asset.

assets.title: Zero book value estimate
assets.requirement: Display the estimated month and year when an asset's book value reaches zero.
assets.open_question: Depreciation method, useful life, residual value, and depreciation start date must already exist or be defined before this can be calculated reliably.

assets.title: Asset status history
assets.requirement: Add a dedicated feature or tab for recording changes in asset status.

assets.title: Asset depreciation behavior
assets.requirement: Asset reductions must affect accounting differently depending on the reason.
assets.warning: The exact accounting mechanics for how a sale changes book value are not fully specified by the source feedback and should not be invented by the implementation agent.

recommended_domain_model.principle: Do not implement each feedback item as an isolated CRUD change. Production, feed, flock/assets, financials, and analytics now depend on each other.

implementation_sequence.name: Data model foundation
tasks: Review existing database models and migrations.
Add system-wide decimal precision where required.
Add transaction quantity and unit price.
Add asset quantity and asset lifecycle records.

implementation_sequence.name: Core business calculations
tasks: Implement feed sack to kilogram conversion.
Implement depreciation zero-date calculation if required inputs exist.

implementation_sequence.name: Asset lifecycle
tasks: Implement dead, sold, and missing reasons.

implementation_sequence.name: Validation and regression testing
tasks: Add backend unit tests for formulas.
Verify existing production, sales, transactions, and assets continue to work.
Verify dashboards against manually calculated sample datasets.

working_style: Inspect the existing repository before making architectural changes.
Reuse existing patterns and abstractions where reasonable.
Do not rewrite working modules unnecessarily.
Prefer database-backed domain values over frontend-only calculations for business-critical data.
Keep business formulas centralized and testable.
Use migrations for database schema changes.
Preserve backward compatibility with existing records where practical.
must_not_assume: Do not invent normal-user permissions not specified by the product owner.
Do not invent kilograms per feed sack.
Do not invent a depreciation method.
Do not invent accounting treatment for sold assets beyond the provided requirement.
Do not silently change existing financial formulas.
Do not assume the FCR target of 0.2 is universally correct without making it configurable or confirming the domain rule.

open_questions.question: How many kilograms are contained in one karung of feed?
Should kilograms per karung be globally configured, configured per feed product, or entered per transaction?
What exact permissions should a normal user have?
What depreciation method is currently used for assets?
How should proceeds from sold assets interact with depreciation and book value?
Is the target FCR of 0.2 confirmed as the intended business target?
Should HDP use an estimated egg count derived from kilograms, or will exact egg count eventually be recorded directly?

definition_of_done: All P0 requirements are implemented and tested.
Production, transaction, sales, and asset workflows remain functional.
FCR and HDP calculations have automated tests.
Dashboard calculations match manually verified sample data.
Authorization rules are enforced by the backend, not only hidden in the frontend.
All unresolved domain assumptions are either configurable or documented rather than hardcoded.
